reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Added ingress-shim option `--extra-certificate-annotations`, which sets a list of annotation keys to be copied from Ingress-like to resulting Certificate object", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: New optional flag; nothing changes for operators who do not set it.

proposed.statement: A new ingress-shim CLI flag `--extra-certificate-annotations` was added, listing annotation keys to copy from Ingress-like objects to the resulting Certificate; it has no operational consequence unless used.
